families.label: R1/R2
families.rationale: The modern R3GAN Stacked-MNIST training adaptation is the canonical baseline. The older fixed R1/R2 penalty on a K3P recipe remains an explicit alternative; different recorded sources are not ranked against one another.

families.label: BCap
families.rationale: Frozen BCap penalty with its declared K3P optimizer and training law.

families.label: KA2
families.rationale: Public KA2 formulation retains its own training mechanism.

families.label: E22
families.rationale: Policy-aware E22 formulation; unsupported frozen hosts remain blocked.

families.label: Atlas
families.rationale: Policy-aware Atlas formulation; unsupported frozen hosts remain blocked.

families.label: GAN v3 release 0.7 (MoG)
families.rationale: The explicit task adaptation is the runnable MoG configuration. The earlier host-incompatible MoG card stays an archived alternative, with its original source and blockers.

families.label: GAN v3 release 0.7 (cloud)
families.rationale: Particle-cloud prior and host law are separate from the learned-MoG family.

families.label: K3P without critic anchor
families.rationale: Removing the critic anchor is a structural ablation, not a tuned K3P configuration.

families.label: K3P without critic penalty
families.rationale: Removing the critic penalty is a structural ablation.

families.label: K3P without A2
families.rationale: Removing A2 is a structural ablation.

families.label: K3P without training output noise
families.rationale: Removing training output noise changes the training law and remains a separate technique.
